successors.name: Kingdom of Alba
successors.text: 'upon his death in 1234, his holdings were divided between his three daughters and their husbands'; Galloway was partitioned after the revolt of 1234-1235 under the Scottish crown

ledger.x: Page silent on a founding: 'Suibne mac Cináeda (d.1034) is the first recorded king of the Gall-ghàidhil'; the succession 'is not properly recorded until about 1138'.
1234: Alan of Galloway dies and the lordship is divided.

wars.name: Galloway revolt
wars.outcome: 'In the ensuing Galloway revolt of 1234-1235, an army of Galwegian rebels ambushed Alexander's royal army'; Gille Ruadh 'led a revolt against Alexander'; the result was 'a partition of Galloway, serving to fragment it administratively'.

certainty.note: The page says the boundaries 'were ill-defined, and varied over time'.
